findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "seo-content" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seo-content_heading-outline-compare · Private data: seo-content_near-duplicate-detect · Public sink: seo-content_tfidf-term-gap, seo-content_brief-from-serp-texts, seo-content_readability-score, seo-content_near-duplicate-detect, seo-content_internal-link-suggest, seo-content_keyword-intent-classify, seo-content_keyword-group-lexical, seo-content_keyword-difficulty-estimate, seo-content_heading-outline-compare, seo-content_serp-snippet-preview, seo-content_content-decay-detect, seo-content_topic-coverage-score, seo-content_share-of-voice-calc, seo-content_rank-change-summary, seo-content_keyword-opportunity-score · Destructive: seo-content_tfidf-term-gap, seo-content_brief-from-serp-texts, seo-content_readability-score, seo-content_near-duplicate-detect, seo-content_internal-link-suggest, seo-content_keyword-intent-classify, seo-content_keyword-group-lexical, seo-content_keyword-difficulty-estimate, seo-content_heading-outline-compare, seo-content_serp-snippet-preview, seo-content_content-decay-detect, seo-content_topic-coverage-score, seo-content_share-of-voice-calc, seo-content_rank-change-summary, seo-content_keyword-opportunity-score.
